name: Acropolis, Athens
description: The Acropolis is a flat-topped rocky hill rising above the centre of Athens, Greece, crowned with temples built in the fifth century BC under the statesman Pericles. The columned Parthenon is the best known, joined by the Propylaea gateway, the Erechtheion and the tiny Temple of Athena Nike. Though a 1687 explosion wrecked the Parthenon, the ruins still dominate the city's skyline.
